title: LibScript T3 Image, Sysroot & Unikernel Synthesis Variables
description: Domain-scoped configuration variables for cross-sysroot staging, offline OS image synthesis, service unit path overrides, and unikernel targets.

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_SYSROOT.description: Target root filesystem staging path when provisioning chroots or OS images.

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_ARCH.description: Target CPU architecture when cross-compiling or building OS images.

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_LIBC.description: Target C standard library implementation (glibc, musl, uclibc, picolibc, nolibc, msvcrt).

LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_OS.description: Target operating system identifier when provisioning or cross-compiling.

LIBSCRIPT_HOST_ROOT.description: Isolated cross-toolchain host directory prefix when bootstrapping or executing inside a container/chroot.

LIBSCRIPT_STAGE.description: Active multi-stage T3 execution plan stage identifier (e.g., stage0, stage1, stage2, stage3).

LIBSCRIPT_IMAGE_BUILD.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating offline sysroot/image synthesis mode so service installers stage unit files without starting host daemons.

LIBSCRIPT_DOS_STRATUM.description: Active DOS kernel capability stratum during sysroot staging (dos16-fcb for MS-DOS 1.25, dos16-handle for MS-DOS 2.0, dos32-dpmi for MS-DOS 4.0 and FreeDOS).

LIBSCRIPT_STRICT_IMAGE_BUILD.description: Flag (0 or 1) enforcing strict native image synthesis and rejecting missing-tool stub fallbacks without writing completion stamps.

LIBSCRIPT_ALLOW_STUB.description: Flag (0 or 1) explicitly permitting structural stub artifacts during unit and dry-run testing when hypervisor or mkfs tools are absent.

LIBSCRIPT_VM_WORKER.description: Virtualization worker backend override (docker, wsl2, qemu, bhyve, omnios-vm) for cross-OS disk and filesystem synthesis.

LIBSCRIPT_UNIKERNEL_FRAMEWORK.description: Target unikernel build framework (unikraft, nanos, osv, rumprun, mirageos) when synthesizing unikernel appliances.

LIBSCRIPT_RELEASEVER.description: Target Enterprise Linux major release version passed to dnf --releasever when staging into LIBSCRIPT_TARGET_SYSROOT.

LIBSCRIPT_SYSTEMD_DIR.description: Override directory for systemd unit and drop-in override files (defaults to /etc/systemd/system).

LIBSCRIPT_LIB_SYSTEMD_DIR.description: Override directory for vendor systemd unit files (defaults to /lib/systemd/system).

LIBSCRIPT_ETC_DIR.description: Override root configuration directory for system service config files (defaults to /etc).

LIBSCRIPT_INITD_DIR.description: Override directory for SysV/OpenRC init.d scripts (defaults to /etc/init.d).

LIBSCRIPT_FREEBSD_RCD_DIR.description: Override directory for FreeBSD rc.d service scripts (defaults to /usr/local/etc/rc.d).

LIBSCRIPT_USR_LOCAL_BIN.description: Override directory for locally installed system binaries (defaults to /usr/local/bin).

LIBSCRIPT_USR_LOCAL_ETC.description: Override directory for locally installed system configuration files (defaults to /usr/local/etc).

LIBSCRIPT_HOME_BASE.description: Base parent directory for user home directories (defaults to /home).

LIBSCRIPT_ROOT_HOME.description: Root user home directory override (defaults to /root).
